title: Xtra Power Awant Ustad Industrial Segmented Diamond Saw Blade for Marble, Granite and Ceramic, 125 mm (1)
description: The Xtra Power Awant Ustad Industrial Segmented Diamond Saw Blade is a premium-grade cutting tool specially designed for professionals and serious DIY enthusiasts working with hard materials. With a diameter of 125 mm (5 inches), this robust blade is engineered to deliver precise and smooth cuts through marbles, granites, and ceramics with outstanding efficiency. The segmented diamond rim design ensures fast cutting performance while maintaining a long blade life, making it a reliable choice for demanding industrial applications. Key specifications include a bore size of 20 mm, a segment height of 12 mm, and a maximum operating speed of 13,300 RPM. The enhanced corrugation design further improves cutting accuracy and reduces heat build-up during operation. Always unplug the saw before mounting the blade, operate only with the saw blade guard in place, and wear appropriate personal protection at all times. Whether you are a contractor, tiler, or stone craftsman, the Awant Ustad Diamond Blade is built to help you get more cuts while saving energy on every job.
